case.title: Room 12 Twice
case.brief: Leila and Jonas arrive at Hotel Aurora on the same night, both holding a confirmation for a Deluxe Double. The front desk says only one of them has a room. Leila insists she booked first. Who is right?

evidence.title: Leila's confirmation (TravelNest)
evidence.body: Deluxe Double, 14–16 Mar, $110/night. Status at time of booking: PENDING PAYMENT. Contact email: leila.m@oldmail.com.

evidence.title: TravelNest payment log
evidence.body: Jan 9 14:02 card ending 4412 verified ($1 hold). Jan 10 09:00 charge of $220 DECLINED: card expired 12/25. Notices sent to leila.m@oldmail.com (3 attempts, no reply).

evidence.title: Hotel booking system
evidence.body: Reservation LM-4471 (Leila M.) auto-cancelled: unpaid after 7 days. Room released to inventory.

evidence.title: Jonas's confirmation (booked direct)
evidence.body: Deluxe Double, 14–16 Mar, $95/night, special web rate. Paid in full by card. Status: CONFIRMED.

evidence.title: Leila to the front desk
evidence.body: I switched to leila.mwangi@mailbox.com in December and haven't opened my old inbox since. I booked first, in January, and I never got a single warning!

evidence.title: Front desk note
evidence.body: Hotel is fully booked tonight. The only Deluxe Double is the one held for Jonas.

questions.q: Why was Leila never warned that her booking was failing?
options: The notices went to an email address she no longer used
The hotel never sent any notice

questions.q: Which detail played no part in Leila losing her room?
options: The warnings going to the old email

case.explanation: Leila's January booking was never paid: the $220 charge was declined on Jan 10 because her card had expired in December. The warnings went to leila.m@oldmail.com, an address she had stopped checking, so the hotel auto-cancelled on Jan 17 and released the room. Jonas booked on Jan 20 and paid in full, so his reservation is the only valid one. His cheaper rate is a red herring; it didn't cause the cancellation.

meta.theme: travel mishap where two bookings conflict
